"You are not ordinary—because the Spirit of God lives in you. His power is in you. His holiness is in you. And in these last days, God is raising a generation that walks in purity and power, light and authority. But here's the key: you cannot walk in divine power without embracing divine nature. In this powerful message, we dive deep into the Nature and Power of God, discovering what it means to live as partakers of the divine nature in a dark and perverse world. Learn how holiness unlocks spiritual power, why staying connected to the source—Jesus—is critical, and how to overcome the enemy’s tactics of corruption and distraction.

Featuring scriptures from Hebrews 1, 1 Peter 1, 2 Peter 1, Ephesians 1 & 6, and more, this message will equip you to live boldly, purely, and powerfully in Christ.

1 corinthians 13:9-11 distinguishes the in-part realm, which is a ministry from the earnest and not the fullness of our ministry. 

1 Corinthians 13:9-12 KJV
For we know in part, and we prophesy in part. [10] But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away. 

At this point, no man will think of ministry from the standpoint of what God has called him to do. He will know that the servant of God is a collective man  that God has called. This body is called the golden candlestick. You may ask how will this happen? It will be by His power. At this time, a child of 7 years old in the church, will be able to cause a 40 year old to tremble. God's Ekklesia will carry power.

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality – V

content.rendered:
Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

MATTHEW 6:10 KJV

The Kingdom of God, according to the bible suffers violence. This is because by the time the Kingdom came, the land was not empty. The inhabitants were not ready to go and the kingdom was not going to go back. Hence, this Kingdom met war. 

Jesus conquered for you and now He is overcoming in you, the relics of those Kings who once ruled over you. Isaiah 26:13 shows that other lords had ruled. Jesus came to destroy the other lords and he did destroy them, 1 John 3:8. However, having destroyed them, whatever they left in you, he is giving you the Holy Spirit a mandate to destroy them, Deuteronomy 33:27.

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality – IV

content.rendered:
Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

MATTHEW 6:10 KJV
The matter of the Kingdom is in the very heart of God. Even before man was conceived, God had this kingdom establishment agenda in His mind. Part of the plan was that a man must be king over the earth and the Lord God will be king over the earth. Because it is the heavens that rule, He the Lord must be king over the earth. There is nothing that can stand in the way of God fulfilling his plan. God will find a man at the end of the day that will rule and govern on the earth. This Man is a collective Christ, Jesus the head and His bride - the church.

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality – Recap

content.rendered:
The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him. [3] Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.

John 3:2-3 KJV

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality III

content.rendered:
Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

MATTHEW 6:10 KJV
God wants you and I to know that He has a Kingdom and you are citizens of the Kingdom of God. Though you are in this world, you cannot think like those in this world, in the futility of their mind. Let the mentality of the Kingdom of God govern your mind. Think as a kingdom person. 
Whose Kingdom? the kingdom of God. 

Man may not respect you, but the Kingdom of darkness knows those in the Kingdom of God. They dare not come near a man who knows who he is in the Kingdom.

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality II

content.rendered:
Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven.

Matthew 6:10 KJV
The Kingdom of God has an order. This is called the divine order. Divine order is instituted by God's supreme dominion. This is the name of the person who owns the Kingdom. Anything that is associated with God in any form must obey that order, else it will be exiled. 

It behooves you who are associated with God to ensure that you are under that order. Everyone is brought under this order including the King Himself. 

The key of maintaining your place in the Kingdom is obedience to the divine order. Right now we are in the school of obedience after which we can avenge disobedience. The order is brought out and enforced by the person of the Holy Spirit. He is the one who institutes and enforces the divine order. As many as are led by the Spirit of God are the citizens of the house God.

title.rendered: The Kingdom Reality

content.rendered:
Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, [15] And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent ye, and believe the gospel.

Mark 1:14-15 KJV
                       Snippets from Sermon

The pursuit of the Kingdom person is to know the King and make Him known. The main pursuit of a Kingdom person is to meet the will of the King and the pleasure of the King.

It is one thing to see the Kingdom of God, and another thing to enter and yet another to inherit the Kingdom. Entering into the Kingdom is by the enabling power of the Holy Spirit and by following Him, you will inherit the Kingdom.

The Holy Spirit is the life flow, the power and the authority of the Kingdom. The Holy Spirit inside of you is your citizenship right. It is what gives you the ability to use the Kingdoms authority. The right, power, privilege and the summation of the Kingdom is given unto you. The Holy Spirit in you is the Kingdom coming to you.

title.rendered: Love – the order of service to the house of God and to those without

content.rendered:
For, brethren, ye have been called unto liberty; only use not liberty for an occasion to the flesh, but by love serve one another.

Galatians 5:13 KJVS
Why love? 

It is the means by which we edify one another. The services we have for one another have to be based on love. 

It is the very essence of the gospel and by it, the world shall know that we are Jesus' disciples. Love is like a badge that you always have to wear. It is the way people identify you as a Christian.

title.rendered: Maintaining the ‘sent’ mentality

content.rendered:
And He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation. [16] He who has believed and has been baptized shall be saved; but he who has disbelieved shall be condemned. [17] These signs will accompany those who have believed: in My name they will cast out demons, they will speak with new tongues; [18] they will pick up serpents, and if they drink any deadly poison, it will not hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

Mark 16:15-18 NASB
The gospel is the most resisted message there has been right from its inception. Why? When it is preached, it convicts the hearer. The gospel has compelling power. It can compel a person to believe. It is like a capsule with the needed faith inside to believe. 

The sad thing is the average christians, though given this message, are ashamed of the gospel. There are two things that hinders the sent one: Timidity and compromise. 

When the 'sent' mentality is lacking, compromise with the world is prevalent.

title.rendered: The Battle Within and Without II

content.rendered:
I will love thee, O LORD, my strength. [2] The LORD is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower. [3] I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies. [4] The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid. [5] The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me. [6] In my distress I called upon the LORD, and cried unto my God: he heard my voice out of his temple, and my cry came before him, even into his ears.

Psalm 18:1-6 KJV
Part of the dyamics of life is that the battles you fight and win is not an end in itself. This means the end of one battle is the beginning of another. However, with each win, confidence should rise in our heart that the One who helped us win the previous will help us win the next!

title.rendered: The Battles within and without

content.rendered:
For though we walk in the flesh, we do not war after the flesh: [4] (For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God to the pulling down of strong holds;) [5] Casting down imaginations, and every high thing that exalteth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ; [6] And having in a readiness to revenge all disobedience, when your obedience is fulfilled.

2 Corinthians 10:3-6 KJV
The entire bible, from the beginning of Genesis to Revelation,  is about battles and survival. For each battle, there are guidelines on how to confront and overcome.  Sometimes the scripture says "beware". In such situations, being aware is the strategy. 

Somewhere else the bible would says "bind and loose". In another, it would say "fight a good fight". In another, it would recognize that you cannot fight alone. In such cases, it would say whatever two or three agree as touching any matter, it shall be done, Matthew 18:19. Here, alliances are formed.Nations form allies, because they want to limit individual casualties and share the victory, so it is in some battles we face.

title.rendered: Why Pray?

content.rendered:
And he spake a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint;

Luke 18:1 KJV
Why-Pray (Transcribed) Download
In the verse above, Jesus spoke a parable and He said, "men ought always to pray and not to faint". This word “ought” implies that men are expected and required to pray and not to faint. This means the opposite is of praying is to faint. What does it mean to faint? It means to lose life. One who faints become temporarily unconscious of their surrounding. If one is not praying, he is fainting. 
 
Another meaning of the word "faint" is to be weary. When people are faced with different trials, if they are not praying, they become temporarily unconscious of the fact that God dwells inside them. Often, we have the mindset that God is a far off. However, in these days, the Lord will make us know that He is not afar off, but nearby

title.rendered: The Law of Love

content.rendered:
Master, which is the great commandment in the law? [37] Jesus said unto him, Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind. [38] This is the first and great commandment. [39] And the second is like unto it, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself. [40] On these two commandments hang all the law and the prophets.

Matthew 22:36-40 KJV
The-law-of-Love (Transcribed) Download
The cross has two arms: the vertical pole and the horizontal pole. The vertical pole is to love God with all your heart and all your soul and mind. This is the basis for all the work we do with the Lord. If we do not have love for God, we cannot do any service to humanity.

True love is the love that God gives and the love we have for God. Out of this love, we give to people. If we love God, we must love our fellow men. This is the law of Love.

title.rendered: The Pearl of Great price

content.rendered:
Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls: [46] Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

Matthew 13:45-46 KJV
The pearl of great price (Transcribed)Download
The first principal merchant man is our Lord Jesus. He was looking for goodly pearls. Firstly, a pearl is a Jewel of high value. The scripture then emphasized that these were not ordinary pearls, but goodly pearls. He found a pearl of great price, that means this pearl was the best of the best. 

Jesus saw the church in the eye of the Spirit and it was of a great price. The church is very valuable and its price is very high. Jesus sold everything. To explain the beauty of this treasure, One man, walking with God, went into Egypt, Moses, and this empire fell. Imagine what would happen with 5 men of such a kind? Imagine a whole church! Creation is waiting for the manifestation of the sons of God.This treasure cost our Lord His Life.

title.rendered: Exhortations from Various ministers.

content.rendered:
How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.

1 Corinthians 14:26 KJV
2 Timothy 2:19 KJV
Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
The Lord knows in the heart those who are following Him and He also has a reward for those who play games. Regardless of peoples belief, He prepares a recompense for those who are on the earth.
The Journey with the Lord is a process. You do not jump ship. Studying daily and frequently is important for a student in school. The one who waits till the last minute has his reward after examination, when his/ her grades come out.
Matthew 25:1-10 speaks of virgins (which speaks of virgin hearted believers). Some where wise and others were foolish. God does not speak in scriptures as an abuse, but on a descriptive level. These foolish did not take time to gather what was needed to walk with the Lord in the long run. 
A person who decide not to follow through with God's warning for character transformation, may at some point in life have people reach out for a fruit, but find none. God always tests our commitments to Him. Matthew 25:6. 

Stay focused! There is a reward for following God.

title.rendered: The Kind of man God will rest upon – 8

content.rendered:
Don’t you realize that in a race everyone runs, but only one person gets the prize? So run to win! [25] All athletes are disciplined in their training. They do it to win a prize that will fade away, but we do it for an eternal prize.

1 Corinthians 9:24-25 NLT
An athlete like Usain Bolt, who does trainings for the 100 Metre race, would begin to train and practice from 4 years before the time. His diets change. The way he sleeps, the exercises he needs to go through for 4 years are often rigorous. All these are for a 10 seconds race. Usain has to embrace a certain kind of lifestyle that will enable him to obtain a prize. 

People who strive for mastery must learn to be temperate in all things. The word, temperate means to exercise self restraint (in diet and chastity).

This involves restraint in your morals, diet, in all things. Ours is for an incorruptible crown.

title.rendered: The Kind of man God will rest upon – 7

Are they ministers of Christ? (I speak as a fool) I am more; in labours more abundant, in stripes above measure, in prisons more frequent, in deaths oft. [24] Of the Jews five times received I forty stripes save one. [25] Thrice was I beaten with rods, once was I stoned, thrice I suffered shipwreck, a night and a day I have been in the deep; [26] In journeyings often, in perils of waters, in perils of robbers, in perils by mine own countrymen, in perils by the heathen, in perils in the city, in perils in the wilderness, in perils in the sea, in perils among false brethren; [27] In weariness and painfulness, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, in cold and nakedness.

2 Corinthians 11:23-27 KJV
What is fasting? The word is nēsteuō which means abstinence. Absitinence is a demonstration of your spirituality. Fasting is abstinence from fleshly pleasures in order to engage in spiritual things. In Isaiah 58:3, Israel said they had a fast and God did not take notice. The Lord said they find pleasure and exact all the labours. This was not a fast, even though they denied themselves of food. 

Fasting is denying yourselves of fleshly pleasure. Someone may say, where is the command to fast? If Jesus fasted and his disciples fasted and  Paul fasted We should be instructed.

title.rendered: The Blessed Man

Blessed (happy, fortunate, to be envied) is everyone who fears, reveres, and worships the Lord, who walks in His ways and lives according to His commandments.

Psalm 128:1 AMPC
SNIPPETS FROM SERMON

God has blessed us in Christ. This blessings comes with fruitfulness. The Lord himself blesses you out of the abundance of His reserves for His children. And your eyes shall see peace upon Israel and the good of Jerusalem. When you pray for the sick, they will be healed. When you go to preach the gospel, people will be saved. This is lot of the man who fears the Lord.

title.rendered: Heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ

content.rendered:
The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God: [17] And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

Romans 8:16-17 KJV
SNIPPETS FROM SERMON

Sometimes when we say we are heirs from God, it may seem like we inherit things from God. However, we are heirs of God, meaning we inherit Him. We are not taking from Him, we are taking Him. To inherit God, we must come through Jesus. Christ is the first born and we share our inheritance with Christ. 

God in His purpose said " I want some people to be conformed to the image of my son. You are a part of those and at the appropriate time He called you. Your salvation did not come to God as a surprise. He predestinated them. Jesus came, died and resurrected, setting a pattern.

Genesis 33:18-20 KJV

Under the theme the fear of the Lord, we will be considering the theme: El Elohe Israel which means the Lord, the Lord God of Israel. A mighty God - He is a covenant keeping, covenant making God. 
When we speak of the fear of the Lord, we are not worshipping someone who is unworthy. He is committed to you and He is worthy of all honour.

title.rendered: The Fear of the Lord

The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple. However, God is saying I am the ultimate "My word was the first word and my word will be the last word, fear me worship ,reverence me.

Jesus's source of strength and power was from His prayer altar. He was so much in fellowship with God in prayer that his life was a blessing. He was always connected to the source of life. Jesus knew that when He ministered, there was a loss in virtue. This happened in the case of the woman with the issue of blood, Mark 5:24-34. 

Hence, He always had to return to the secret place to get a replenishing from His Father. The key to effectual ministry is your connection to the source of power. Tremendous power is made available as you pray. This was why Jesus was able to do good and bless lives as He prayed. His words are still being remembered today, because he was a man of prayer. Never neglect the secret place!

 2. Adamic moral failures (a lack of moral compass). 3. Adamic cursed circumstances.

Therefore take no thought, saying, What shall we eat? or, What shall we drink? or, Wherewithal shall we be clothed? 32  (For after all these things do the Gentiles seek:) for your heavenly Father knoweth that ye have need of all these things.33 But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.

What is the Kingdom of God? It is a person, Jesus Christ in us. Matthew 6:33 says “But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you”. This means by priority, the Kingdom of God must be manifested in your lifestyle. Doing things in the right way is living is righteousness. Therefore, sometimes, the bible would call a person who was not a Jew, righteous, Acts 10:22. There is a right way, a kingdom way to do everything including prayer, giving, living every day life, leisure, marriage, etc. The Kingdom of God is also not meat and drink or material things, as the Jews mistook it to mean, Romans 14:17. It is the power of the Holy Spirit operating in a person to bring righteousness, peace and Joy in the Holy spirit. If a person is struggling with any of these, they have most likely deviated from the path of the Kingdom.

title.rendered: The Way of the Wayfarers – 7

content.rendered:
And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

ISAIAH 35:8 KJV
The greatest name you can be called in the body of Christ is “brother or sister”. Jesus Himself is not ashamed to be called our brother, because we and Him are all of one God, Hebrews 2:11. He mingled so much with his disciples that they needed someone to point out who He was among them when they came to arrest Him in Gathsemene, John 18:3-8. There is an onslaught coming against the church, great persecution which Jeremiah 30:7 calls the day of Jacobs trouble. The visible church will be the first target, their leaders being the first. Beloved, for the salvation of both your life and your soul do not be called anything but brother or sister. God is king and we are all brethren. Hence, leadership in the new testament is plural with no one man leader. Ideally, a true minister of God should minister himself out of ‘relevance’. John ministered and left the scene for Jesus, John 3:30. Jesus did greater works and left the scene, allowing us to do greater works, John 14:12. This is the due order. When a man stands to ministers for 10, 20, 30 years and no one can be said to do greater works than he did, he has most likely become idol shepherd, ministering himself and not the true gospel.

The emphasis of this way of holiness is Jesus. The call is to move beyond, but not without Pentecost. That is going with the truths that God has passed down through the various moves from Luther to Seymour and secondly the priesthood of all believers where even the least among the church (the newest believer) can hear from God and be a blessing. This is the due order.

God’s plan is to build His church, a church in which the gates of hell will not prevail against. From the beginning, whenever there was a deviation from His purpose, He moved to bring about a recovery. This recovery involved calling men and women out of institutions that He had previously established, but which had turned their back on Him. After the death of the apostles, the church moved into what is known as the dark ages, where the true Word of God was hidden and men only followed what they were told by the Vatican. Out of this came Luther and then John Wesley, the evangelicals, the baptists and the pentecostals. Now that there has been another deviation and a massive one from the path of God, God has begun to move again in this generation.

When man fell, he took up the very nature of satan. Man did not become simply a sinner but sin itself. This was the reason for Job’s question. No man could do this, but only Only God has the power, the ability and the resources to bring out cleanliness out of the unclean. He has made us Holy. This is why Paul can call us Holy brethren, partakers of the heavenly calling, in Hebrews 3:1. Holiness has become the house of God, which we are. Understand this beyond all doubt that you are Holy, Beloved. Ezekiel 43:12 shows that the whole portion of the house is Holy, everything, is to be Holy. title.rendered: The way of the Wayfarers – 4

content.rendered:
And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.

ISAIAH 35:8 KJV
The desire and move of God since the fall had been to bring man back to Himself and so He created a way. In John 14:6, Jesus said “I am the way, the truth and the life and that no one comes to the Father but by Me”. From the fall, man was subjected to death and so his pursuit was for life. However, life could only be found in the tree of life, which was guarded by a flaming sword. The reason for this is that man was sinful and was approaching a Holy God. The Holiness of God is what sets Him apart. Only that which is Holy can approach God. God’s holiness can be illustrated to a degree by the sun. We are millions of miles away from the sun, yet in the summer, the heat can be excruciating that people die from a heat wave. Imagine being a mile away from the sun. A person would need to be like the sun to approach the sun. In a similar way, God is committed to raising holy men and women who will stand before Him.

The way is not man's idea. It is not politics or democracy. God leads, not man. In Exodus 13:17-18, Moses wrote that the Lord chose not to lead the people through the easy road or the path of the Philistines, but through the wilderness. God led them by the pillar of cloud by day and the pillar of fire by night. During the time of Moses, everyone could see the cloud. If Moses was sleeping and cloud begun to move, a little child could see it and would come and wake Moses up. This is because God is the one leading and not a man. These men also had the Urim and Thummim for direction. They are a prophetic people. They are in the wilderness and so they cannot afford to move without the direction of the Lord.

The word "brotherly kindness" speaks of fraternal affection. It is slightly different from Agape, which is unconditional love. This is a fondness for the brethren, a bond formed by a shared desire to do the will of the Father. David and Jonathan exemplified this affectionate love in 1 Samuel 20:17. The brethren is the strongest fraternity since the beginning of time, and it is bounded by a code of unfeigned love.

How do we grow in grace?
 God give us grace equally, contrary to popular opinion. Has God given us 100% capacity of grace? Yes. Are we all working in it? No. The disparity is growth in grace. God did not give some men more grace and some less grace. There is, however, a difference in experience. Grace is from the Greek word 'karis', Gift is 'karisma'. Having gifts differing means, a person can be a manager of Sales and another a manager in technology. However, they are both managers. We defer in expression. title.rendered: The Name of the Lord

content.rendered:
• The name of the Lord as Authority.

The word name in the Hebrew scriptures is ‘shem’, which stands for authority. The name of the Lord is the authority of the Lord. As believers when you have been translated from the kingdom of darkness into the kingdom of God, Colossians 1:13, you have certain rights and privileges. However, it is knowledge and faith that gives us access to it. Psalm 49:20, Galatians 4:1. We have to know that the name is powerful and understand what Jesus has done and why it is powerful to utilize effectively. The name has been freely given to the church as long as you are a believer, it requires that we grasp an understanding, to know this absolutely to use it.

A case study to understanding this authority will be from the book of Esther 3. 7- 15. “ And the king took his ring from his hand, and gave it unto Haman the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the Jews’ enemy … in the name of King Ahasuerus was it written, and sealed with the king’s ring”. We could see from the story above the power of the kings’ ring. The entire nation knew the power of the kings’ signet ring, symbolizing his authority. Haman could write anything and seal it with the kings’ signet ring and it was taken as the word of the King since it was sealed in his name and with his signet ring. The king did not have to know about Haman’s’ decree for it to be law. It just has to be sealed in his name. In a similar way, we have the name of the Lord, which everything in heaven and on the earth and beneath the earth recognize and submit to. Matthew 28:18, Philippians 2:9-11. Anything you say in prayer in Jesus’ name is done. We do not need to go back to God to get approval and authority over prayers when He has given us this authority already.

In Esther 8, we can see Esther’s response to the king. She sought to reverse that which Haman had decreed, but that could not be done. The king gave a response “Write ye also for the Jews, as it liketh you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring: for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may no man reverse. Esther 8:8. In a similar way, we should have confidence, seeing the name of Jesus as His signet ring, when we pray in the name of Jesus.

Jesus said, And in that day ye shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it to you. John 16:23. We do not need to meet Him for another authority when we ask in His name. We see that only the Lion of the tribe of Jesus can lose that which has been sealed by God, Revelation 5, and if He says He will do what we ask, then we should have the confidence to use His name. No other power can cancel that which is sealed in the name of Jesus. Jesus is described as the Amen, Revelations 3:14. Everything in His name is verily and done. God knew we would need as a powerful tool, so He highly exalted the name Jesus above every name named even in the ages to come. Ephesians 1:21

  • Having the name as an identity/ a seal upon our forehead.

Many will say to me in that day, Lord, Lord, have we not prophesied in thy name? and in thy name have cast out devils? and in thy name done many wonderful works? And then will I profess unto them, I never knew you: depart from me, ye that work iniquity. Matthew 7:22-23.  A question that could pop in our minds would be, how can people prophesy in God’s name and do miracles and Jesus says, they work iniquity (lawlessness) and He never knew them? There is a distinction between using the name of the Lord and having the name of the Lord written in your forehead, as an identity. Revelations 22:4. Having His name as a seal on your forehead means, you are God’s own. We are to desire this as believers. In the kingdom of God, there are distinctions. Looking at Ezekiel 9:4-6, we see a sealing of some, out of God’s people.  And the LORD said unto him, Go through the midst of the city, through the midst of Jerusalem, and set a mark upon the foreheads of the men that sigh and that cry for all the abominations that be done in the midst thereof. Ezekiel 9:4. This sealing was done out of Jerusalem, a called people, starting from His sanctuary, meaning not all in Jerusalem were sealed. In Revelations 7:1-8, we see a similar situation, a sealing of some out of the tribes of Israel. God doesn’t seal you when you’re perfect, but He looks at your heart and if He sees that your heart is crying out to be righteous, to hate every form of wickedness, He places a mark of ownership upon you. 2 Timothy 2:19 says, Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity. Those that have the seal of the Lord are those that are His, those who depart from iniquity.

  • The name of the Lord as a defence

The name of the Lord is a strong tower; The righteous runs to it and is safe and set on high [far above evil]. Proverbs 18:10 (AMP). The word ‘tower’ here signifies a high place, an elevated surface. Once we call upon the name of the Lord it is like He has carried us on eagles’ wings far above principalities and powers, to heavenly heights. In Ezekiel 9 and Revelations 7, there was a judgement to be executed, but it did not begin until the seal had been placed on God’s own. The name places us in a place of safety far from calamities and evil. It keeps us in the heavens constantly. We run into the fortress of God when we call upon the name of the Lord. It is our hiding place. Romans 10:13.

  1. Satan trembles at the mention of the name.

It is easy for us to get familiar with the name of Jesus because we use it frequently, but the devils are subject to and fear the name of Jesus. Luke 10:17. When the apostles began to preach, out of fear, the authorities commanded them not to teach in that name. They feared the name.

Colossians 2:10-15 speaks of the victory of Christ over the enemy.

“When He had disarmed the rulers and authorities [those supernatural forces of evil operating against us], He made a public example of them [exhibiting them as captives in His triumphal procession], having triumphed over them through the cross”.

Colossians 2:15 [AMP]

The Message translation puts it in an interesting way.

“He stripped all the spiritual tyrants in the universe of their sham authority at the Cross and marched them naked through the streets”

Colossians 2:15[MSG}.

Satan and the powers of darkness will never forget the day they were put to a public spectacle. He knows the victory has been won and when we say the name of Jesus, we appropriate the victory. Satan remembers that He was destroyed at the cross. Hebrews 2:14-15. He is afraid when we mention the name of God.

  • The name of the Lord allows us to speak as one having authority.

And it came to pass when Jesus had ended these sayings, the people were astonished at his doctrine: For he taught them as one having authority, and not as the scribes.

Matthew 7:28-29.

Having the name of the Lord helps us not only to pray as one having authority but to teach the word as one having authority. Using the word of God and sealing it with the name of the Lord is powerful. It is a guaranteed prayer already, Isaiah 55:11. In the example of Moses and the red sea in Exodus 14:14-16, God told him to stop crying and use the rod (the word also means sceptre, symbolizing power and authority). He had already been given the authority. We are to just speak the word and use the name, Jesus. We are to speak life into situations and seal it with the name of Jesus.

Knowing this, we should not pray and be agitated like the heathens do, but pray knowing we have the backing and authority of the almighty God. Matthew 6:7-8. His name is I AM that I AM, this is a blank cheque. Exodus 3:14, God is our ever-present help in time of need, Psalm 46:1 and is to us what we need: healer, teacher, Father, Friend, Lover, Strength, Salvation, Righteousness, Sanctifier. You name it, He is!

Therefore, my people shall know my name: therefore, they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I. Isaiah 52:6

The Grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your Spirit!

title.rendered: Third Day of Creation (Genesis 1)

content.rendered:
In this meditation, we are continuing our study on Genesis 1, the bringing forth of the new creation man. God has initiated a project and He will surely complete it. We saw from verse 1 and 2 the first day, which was marked by an evening and a morning. We first explained what the evening and morning is in relation to our lives. We said there are six cycles of evenings and morning to bring us to the estate where there is no more evening, an unending day, Zechariah 14:7. Between each cycle of evening and morning, there are 4 cardinal watches; the evening watch, midnight, early morning (cock crow) and in the morning. Surely, He must come in the morning. We must learn to navigate through the watches, that when He comes in the morning, we might be prepared to receive Him. The scripture has four words used to define the coming of the Lord; the Parousia (which defines His presence), the Epiphaneia of the Lord (which defines His unveiling), the Apocalypses (The revelation) and the Basilea (His Kingdom revealed). The first two are brought forth in the evening and morning. Through the evening and the midnight, time is the Parousia (the time when He is with you by His Spirit and by His Word). He is with you, but you do not see Him, it takes faith to relate with Him in His presence. An example is we are in a dark room and I know a friend is in the room, I cannot really relate to his location. Although he is there, I cannot relate tangibly to his presence. I could hear his voice. We can continue throughout the night, but I have no idea if he is at my front or back. As we continue through to the morning, the light begins to shine, and I can see him and tell what he is wearing and how he really looks like. In the day time is the Epiphaneia. He had always been there, but the light came to shine and reveal Him. He may have been sitting in the same place all though, but the light makes the difference. This is the manner of the coming of the Lord. Even though we have not seen Him, yet we love Him, but soon, we shall see Him as He is. 1 Corinthians 13:12. God always starts His work in the evening and ends it in the morning. Sometimes He feels far, sometimes He feels close, but He is the same, He is with us forever. Matthew 28:20, Hebrew 13:5. What prevents us from relating to His presence is the absence of light, that is why we must be glued to His word because that is the only light, we have in this night time. We must be glued to worshipping and praising Him even when we do not feel like it. We must always have this assurance with us, He is with us. If the devil succeeds in making us doubt this, he sees it as an opportunity to strike. When the Israelites left Egypt, the first battle that was initiated by doubt;

then came the Amalekites. They asked, “Is God amongst us or not”, Exodus 17. Never let the enemy get you to the point where you doubt His presence. It was a very fierce battle, Moses had to hold his hand up till they obtained the victory. However, God did not condemn them for their unbelief, instead, He swore to wipe out the Amalekites. This is the kind of Father we serve. God will NEVER take side with your enemy or support anything that disturbs your peace. The enemy uses what you give to him to fight you if you do not equip him, he is powerless. Faith honours God, fear honours the devil. Choose to honour God by walking in faith. Make that decision in your heart to honour God by faith and He will surely honour you. Each evening and morning come with a development, a growth and a manifestation of God. When He started there was darkness (the evening) and He said let there be light and there was light (day), but there was still a mixture of light and darkness and He separated the two, making a clear distinction. This was the next phase of God’s work in our redemption. Light is the knowledge of God as revealed in the Holy Scriptures, 2 Corinthians 4:6. Ignorance is darkness, and this destroys Hosea 4:6. Hence He says “the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the LORD’s glory, as the water covers the sea” Habakkuk 2:14, first our earth. This happens as we continually behold His face, in the Word. In the old testament, they could not behold Moses’ face. However, in Christ, it is not so, the veil is removed. 2 Corinthians 3:13-18. How is the veil removed, that a mortal man, whose eye does not have enough strength to behold the magnitude of the light emanating from God’s presence, can behold Christ? Good question, it is because He is the one beholding Himself. He put Himself inside of you. The Spirit of the Lord in the heart of man is more precious than Gold. Celebrate the Spirit of God in your life! 2 Corinthians 4:7. Always learn to ask Him for help. All the glory must be to Him when you know that you are an earthen vessel, you will not look to you. Pause and read Psalm 84. The valley of Baca is the valley of pain and weeping and those who sow in tears, through the evening shall doubtless come with rejoicing. Psalm 126:5-6, Psalm 30:5. What is the weeping about? It is the longing to see Him, to be with Him. Any other pain is only a reminder that we need Him. Psalm 42:1 says as the deer pants after the water brook so My soul pants after the Lord. A deer pants for the water brook when it is in a life and death situation, perhaps when struck by an archer, to revive itself. When we have any discomfort about the issue of life, let us run to Him.

Watch ye therefore: for ye know not when the master of the house cometh, at even, or at midnight, or at the cockcrowing, or in the morning:

Mark 13:35

The above verse shows the times the Lord comes. Those who are not watching are those who sleep through the night, we must learn to be awake in the night season. 1 Thessalonians 5:5. Globally, the church is in it’s evening time, in the night season. A lot of people are sleeping, though physically active. Relative to the program of God, they are asleep and hence we keep announcing His coming and reminding ourselves, so we stay awake. The church of His purpose is at the break of the new day. In the previous meditation, we spoke of the firmament (the heavens), speaking of His government been installed in your life, Daniel 4:26. We can see a type of this in the Children of Israel. After He delivered them from Egypt, He brought them to Sinai where He installed His government over them. He set up the leadership, the worship, the priesthood. The same way we do not know where our physical firmament begins and where it ends, so is His government, Isaiah 9:7. Above the firmament is His throne. God tells you plainly, I am your King, submit to Me. He will not submit to you, we must submit to Him. Genesis 1 refers to the individual, the church and the world at large. This meditation is focused on the individual. One of the things He is going to show you is that there is a difference between your spirit; His Spirit and your spirit working together and your soul. Before now, the soul has been the one predominant. When you get saved, He separates the two. Your spirit and His Spirit together bear witness that you are a child of God, Romans 8:16. They sit in the heavens; hence you are not confused about what is the Spirit and what is the soul. The soul had been fighting against God, by the enabling power of the Spirit, you know how to put your soul under subjection. The soul comprises of your will, emotions, desire and your mind. These are the four corners of the earth as we see shortly. The word of God, which is the authority of God, separates your soul from the Spirit, Hebrews 4:12. To give in to this division, we must continually appreciate the Word. We must meditate on the Word of God. Considering what happens next, Genesis 1:9-13, He begins to work on the soul. You will understand the soul is a fruitful land, God’s vineyard. Isaiah 58:11. If you leave it uncultivated, it becomes a place for all manner of beasts. From this point on, His major concern is working on the earth(your soul); salvation, deliverance, until He finally says let us make man in our image. The first thing He does is to separate the dry land from the sea. The dry land speaks of barrenness. Amid that water,

there is still bareness. It is as His Spirit works on your soul that this becomes evident. Even this is good before God, the sea and the earth. As long as He continues the work of redemption, it is good. If we do not yield to the Lord, the earth becomes dry and the sea turns to the evil one. Isaiah 57:20. He makes even the sea to bring forth and He blesses all that it brings forth. These are the stages we go through in redemption. From now on, the focus is on fruitfulness, God desires fruitfulness. The earth brings forth trees whose seed is in itself. The fruit is the character of God and the nature of God, Galatians 5:22-23. The seed is the Word of God, Luke 8:11, John 15:16. Those trees that we begin to see are the trees of righteousness, the plantings of the Lord, Isaiah 61:3. The fruit is in the seed because God expects a propagation of it. This should strike a chord in you, about the nature of God. When God is in control, there is absolute liberty, but when a man is in control, there is bondage.  God gives you the liberty to reproduce after His likeness. Hence the issue with institutionalized Christianity, men are reproducing after the likeness of the pastor and not God. It should not be so among us. Matthew 23:8, Matthew 20:25-28. Every joint must supply to keep the body functioning. Ephesians 4:11-16. Once Gods government comes over your life, He begins to demand the fruit. This is the work of the third day. Because the heavens begin to hear your earth. Hosea 2:21-22 says” And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth; [22] And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel”. Jezreel means God will sow. God sows righteousness and His nature. The process begins from the heavens because the heavens dictate. When the heavens hear, it will respond with the rain that will bring forth fruitfulness. This is what happens in Genesis 1, God had sowed fruitful in us, he made the earth to bring forth. Our soul becomes a well-watered garden.  This will bring forth after the nature of God and afterwards, He commands the trees to replenish the earth. Next, we will consider the fourth day and see how the new man will emerge to have dominion over the earth. Right now, He is still in the womb of God. When He emerges, there is no more night.

Therefore they shall come and sing in the height of Zion, and shall flow together to the goodness of the LORD, for wheat, and for wine, and for oil, and for the young of the flock and of the herd: and their soul shall be as a watered garden; and they shall not sorrow any more at all. Jeremiah 31:12 KJV

The Grace of the Lord be with your spirit.

title.rendered: Second Day of creation   (Genesis 1)

content.rendered:
We had established in the last meditation, that the entirety of Genesis 1 is the unveiling or bringing to birth of the new creation man. It shows the steps that bring to light the emergence of the new creation man, the man who will have dominion over all creation, the man in the image and the likeness of God. Genesis 1:26-27. Psalm 8:4-6 says

“What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him? [5] For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels [Elohim}, and hast crowned him with glory and honour. [6] Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all things under his feet:”.

Psalm 8:4-6 KJV

This was a position meant for Adam, but he never got to it, the condition for him to get there was to eat the tree of life, Genesis 3:22-24. That which he had missed out on, we have an opportunity to partake, In fact, the tree of life and the river of life is inside of you. Revelation 2:7, 1 John 5:5. The new creation man is a mobile garden of Eden, Christ is the tree and the water of life. Isaiah 58:11, John 4:14. You are a completely new species of Gods creation, 2 Corinthians 5:17. You are a mystery revealed, Gods divine mystery hid throughout the ages, which the prophets sought to understand. The fact that we were picked from the gentile world makes it a deeper mystery, even to the Israelites. Ephesians 3:1-10. Do not consider yourself a mistake, Psalm 8:4-6, you are divinely thought of and He has now given you His Holy Spirit. You are God’s workmanship and He is the one doing the work in you, which He will surely complete. Ephesians 2:10. God’s workmanship is flawless and blameless. You might not see yourself as such and people around you may not see you that way, but it is God who assesses you and places you in the position you are. The glorious thing you can do that will gladden the Father’s heart is to continually address yourself the way He addresses you. You honour Him by doing so. If it is in the scripture, then it is true, believe it.

Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who hath blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ: [4] According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love:

Ephesians 1:3-4 KJV

Until you begin to see yourself the way He sees you, you can never become it. You can do whatever you want, be it penance, you can afflict yourself, but you will never move an inch closer to what God has for you. However, if in the simplicity of faith, you take the word of God as it is and call it over your life and believe it over your life, you will move at a greater speed and arrive at a destination. He has given you His word and this Word is the same Word He used to frame the world, Hebrews 11:3, and that Word cannot fail. Blessed is the one who believes what is written for he shall see the performance of it. Luke 1:45. The just shall live by faith. Considering Genesis 1:1-3, we said previously that the essence of the new creation man is light. The fertilized egg that caused the emergence of the new creation man is light, hence, whatever comes forth must be perfect light. God is light, 1 John 1:5. He calls this light to come forth from the dark regions of our heart. He took the new creation material from the fallen Adam that was without form and void and darkness filled his heart. When he says Lord Jesus, be My saviour, instantly, light breaks forth into that dark region. 2 Corinthians 4:6. However, this light is amid the darkness. This darkness is your minds belief, contradictions that you may face (lust, pride), struggles and weaknesses of the flesh, but despite this, there is the light. The light may appear little, but keep watching it, it will grow into a day star. 2 Peter 1:19. Watching it entails reading the bible, whether you understand it or not, ask for understanding, the more you do this, the more this light grows till it becomes a Sun. As we said in the previous meditation, 6 circles of evening and morning must occur till we come to the fullness where there is no more night, a perpetual day. As we said, entering into the seventh day is a corporate affair.

Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before … Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.

Philippians 3:13,16

We should have the attitude of Paul. Wherever you have attained, the rule is the same. The only thing that goes against the rule is to turn back from being consistent. Hebrews 10:38. If all you know is John 3:16, hold on to it faithfully and the Lord will do quick work and cut it short in righteousness, Romans 9:28. For a thousand years to Him is as a day, 2 Peter 3:8. That is, what was meant to take 1000 years can be finished in 1 day. If you are already at the 6th evening and morning and you are about to press on, you will enter into it. However, when it comes to the time of breaking forth into the fulness, you must wait for your brethren. This is where intercession comes in. Just like in the time of Pentecost, Acts 2, the day must fully come, no one is going ahead of his brother. Joshua and Caleb were ready to enter the promised land 40 years ahead of time. They trusted God and believed God, but as long as those that had unbelief were dying, they could not go in. If Joshua and Caleb had known this by revelation, before they went to spy the land, they may have prayed perhaps and bound the spirit of unbelief. They may have even agreed with their brethren that they should keep quiet while they speak. However, their brethren kept speaking negatively, that they called themselves grasshoppers. The next most tragic moment happened after the fall, the bible said they wept all through the night. God called it a breach and He swore that these will not enter His rest, only Joshua and Caleb did, 40 years after. He said as truly as I live, the knowledge of My glory shall cover the earth. The Israelites were supposed to be the ones to reveal the knowledge of God, but they counted themselves unworthy and He took time to bury them in the wilderness. Numbers 14:1-24. What should we learn from this? Only declare what God says, never entertain unbelief or drawback. Say what He says about you. Wherever you are, be faithful and you will make it. Genesis 1 said He created light and divided it from darkness, He gave the man to choose. Anywhere you see God dividing something, it is Him giving a choice. That is in harmony with His Divine nature. As a born-again child of God, you have the right to make a choice. When you were in darkness, there was no choice. Now, If you choose light and follow after light, you live. It is your birthright as a born-again child of God to choose.

That is what differentiates man from other creatures, you can choose to follow God or to go back to your old life, to serve Him fully or partially. He said I place before you, life and death and He counsels you to choose life. Deuteronomy 30:15-20. Each person will have different temptations. God will allow them because He must give you the right to make a choice, this is the first thing you encounter when you become born again, choice. Jesus asked Peter after he had gone fishing again if he loved him, this is because he had to make a choice if he would choose Jesus or his trade. John 21. Never you think it will not come, it will always come until we reach the fullness. We must resolve at all times to choose God, to choose light. It might cost you friends, family or even your life. He will make the choice clear, that you will make an intelligent choice. Hence it is said that whatsoever is born of God cannot willfully sin because the Seed of God is within Him. 1 John 3:9. The seed of God is light, you cannot choose darkness. God called light day and the darkness He called night. Whatsoever you call, you have mastery over it. Once a man can begin to assign names to these things, he has come into a level of conquest, of victory. May this be our portion. Because you have called darkness a name, you govern it. Whatever name you call them, that is what they are. Darkness is night and it is not a time for a man. Because of the limitations the night brings, you don’t love the night, you love the day. You gain mastery over it, you can separate the two of them and choose light. Once you choose light, you become a child of the day. 1 Thessalonians 5:5. He trains you to use your senses to discern between good and evil. Hebrews 5:14. We must exercise our spiritual senses to discern good and evil, this is by taking in the word of God, Romans 12:2.
In Genesis 1:6-8, God introduced another thing that is going to bring about a clear distinction, the firmament. The firmament reveals His power, where He stands upon, Psalm 150:1. He brings His government over your life. You begin to feel the weight of it. Hitherto, it has been a choice, but when He has seen that there is faithfulness in the right choice, He installs His government. It is a beautiful thing and it makes choices very easy. You are empowered to make goodly choices, to choose light. This firmament separates the waters above from the waters beneath. When one is born again, the Spirit comes alive and the soul remains, the firmament separates between the Spirit and soul and sets His government over your soul. Ezekiel 1:22-26 describes this.

You are a living creature; the church of the firstborn is the living creature. This is where He sets His throne. His government brings upon you a constraint and it teaches you how to kill self and the enemy. It equips you with the armoury to live victoriously over sin. You do not only choose now, but you choose with the mindset to destroy the enemy. He empowers you to do so, His government is the power of His might that strengthens you. Ephesians 6:10-12. This happens when we get baptised in the Holy Spirit. You might have been previously led by the reactions of men, but now, you are being led by the Spirit of God. Romans 8:14. The ‘waters above’ is the Spirit and the ‘water below’ is your soul. You will see later, that the water below separates into the land and the sea and the both must bring forth. As you allow His government to be upon you, the earth will bring forth goodly things and the sea as well. This will be the topic of another meditation. However, know that the second day is the day of His rulership. He lowers His hand upon your head. That head is your mind, the love of Christ constrains you, you cannot do what you want, He is your Lord. This is because, at the final stage, He will stamp out everything that is of the old, that you will not even remember sin.


Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth. Psalm 110:3 KJV

The Grace of the Lord be with your Spirit.

title.rendered: First Day of Creation (Genesis 1)

content.rendered:
Genesis Day 1.

There are 6 days of work shown in Genesis 1. In this meditation, we will consider day one and see the work the Lord did on the first day. The first day is very important, the beginning of God’s creation.

“In the beginning God created the heaven and the earth. And the earth was without form, and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters. And God said, let there be light: and there was light. And God saw the light, that it was good: and God divided the light from the darkness. And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Night. And the evening and the morning were the first day.”

Genesis 1:1-5

Here, we see the beginning of God’s creation. When we read this, our minds naturally go to the physical creation, the trees. This is not what God is referring to in this passage. The trees and all the physical things we see, were brought forth in Genesis 2. What we are reading in Genesis 1, is God declaring ahead of time the bringing forth of the new creation man. It is God announcing and revealing the process by which the new creation man will emerge. Every act of God that we see in Genesis 1 are the divine work of God in the church and in the believers life to produce the man that will eventually stand. All the 6 days of creation, each one coming forth at the command of the word of God are all a foretell of what God has in mind to bring forth the new creation man. Who is the new creation man? This is the man that bears the full image and likeness of God, this is God reproducing Himself, multiplying Himself over the whole Universe. The new creation man as we see in Ephesians 4:23-24

And be renewed in the spirit of your mind; And that ye put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness

Ephesians 4:23-24

This new man is renewed by the knowledge of God, Colossians 3:10. Paul in speaking about the new man is referring to Genesis 1. If there is a new man, there is an old man. The new man is expected to swallow up the old man. Hence, after God made him, He told him to have dominion, Genesis 1:26-27. He will have to subdue the old man. Before the coming for h of the new creation, the old has always been there. The entire process given to us in Genesis 1 is the process it takes to be able to be fruitful, multiply, replenish the earth, subdue it and have dominion. Genesis 1:28

The very first thing He said was “let there be light”. The essence, the instrument used to bring forth the new man is light. The new man is a product of life. What is light? What is darkness? Simply put, light is knowledge and darkness is ignorance. Knowledge of what? Knowledge of the most high God. This knowledge is communicated to us in two specific ways; (i) by experience, koinonia (fellowship). This is an experiential knowledge of Him. This takes time, but this is the enduring knowledge of Him. This requires several evening and morning and each cycle of them bring to you an impartation of His divine knowledge. When It says evening and morning make the first day, each of those days bring to you an experiential knowledge of God. However, God is merciful. He knows that if we continue the way we are now for millions of years, we cannot know Him, even if we are reading our bible and praying every day. And so, He brings in the other knowledge, (ii) The revelation knowledge of Him. Through the revelation knowledge, He surpasses your mind. He overrules your limitations and imparts you with a knowledge of Him, this is what the bible calls the Epignosis, Ephesians 1:17-19. The other knowledge is the gnosis, which comes by fellowship, interaction, by living in His revealed knowledge. You come to know Him by interaction. This exposes all the darkness within. However, God in His mercy knowing fully well our frame, gives us this other means of knowing Him, by revelation. Now revelation is not by scholarship. It is the prerogative of the Revelator. He decides what He reveals, when he reveals it, How He reveals it, to what extent He reveals it. The only thing you can do is to cooperate with him and put yourself in the place He can reveal Himself to you. Most of the time, where He reveals Himself is not in a palatable place. Those who are seeking personal pleasure may always be out of the sphere of divine revelation. However, if you have learned that in walking with God, God takes you through evening and night seasons, where there is darkness and complete ignorance to God, He comes as an intervention and gives you light and so it says in the evening time, there shall be light Zechariah 14:7. He gives light to accelerate your knowledge of him, but it is in the midst of darkness. Usually, this revelation comes in the midnight hour. God is a faithful and a kind God, He must make you pass. In God’s lecture, nobody fails. As long as you are faithfully attending the class, you can never fail. Isaiah 40:26. He teaches you by the greatness of His might. It is not an accumulation of head knowledge. It is an impartation of life. The ability to preach does not show the knowledge of God, this knowledge is worked into you, He engraves it into you. Hebrews 10:16, Jeremiah 31:33-34. He has done it, the given of the Holy Spirit is the mark of the new creation. 1 John 2:20, John 16:13. Your teacher is within you. You can listen to a thousand sermons, but it only the one that the Lord engraves in your heart that is yours. When it is engraved in your heart, it is permanent, if a man teaches you, you might forget.

The earth was without form and void and so that He does not leave you in the dark as to what form and void means. He says darkness was upon face the deep. The void and the formlessness is as a result of darkness, Jeremiah 4:23. The darkness is located on the face of the deep and so when God said let there be light, it was right in the face of the deep that He commanded the light. From 2 Corinthians 4:6, we can then see that the deep is our heart, but the face of the deep is our mind. So far, the enemy is able to torment our minds. When one comes to salvation, the Spirit is saved, the heart is captured by the Lord, however, our minds need deliverance. Darkness is the weapons of the enemy. The bible says the devil blinds the mind of people to the gospel, 2 Corinthians 4:4. Darkness is ignorance, he takes away the knowledge of God. There is nothing that frightens the devil more than when men know God. However, the earth will be filled with the knowledge of God, despite what the devil does. Habakkuk 2:14. In the new creation, the law is put in our minds, the putting in of the word of God is the commanding of the light to shine. The rabbi’s reading this might have wondered how this will be, knowing that the law was in one chest somewhere and they alone had access to it. They read with a veiled face, but the bible says we behold Him with an open face, 2 Corinthians 3:18. Hence He says we shall know Him, He said that with a note of authority, Jeremiah 31:31-34. The process of knowing Him may be tough but be rest assured that whatever you are going through, God will engrave in you His knowledge. When He took the Israelite through the wilderness and there was no water and they came to Mara, which had bitter waters, He let them know that He will take sickness away from them. Exodus 15:22-27. They finally found water and it was bitter and some began to complain. Never you complain. Don’t complain against God or your brother or any man. That is a fruit of the devil and not of God. If you need a change, go on your knees. These people were inflicted with the demon of complaining. 10 times they complained, and God was grieved, and God destroyed them in the wilderness. Psalm 95:10, Hebrews 3:8-12, 1 Corinthians 10:1-11. He is faithful who has called you, He will also perfect all that concerns you. The first thing that comes is life, this is to them that treasure their relationship with Him, He visits them in the midnight hour, Matthew 25:6. Why didn’t He visit Paul and Silas in the afternoon, why did He wait till midnight? In there they learned the ability of God to deliver you no matter what the circumstance is. Acts 16:52-34. From then, a sudden boldness entered Paul such that He was confident to stand before kings. The midnight hour is the darkest and just after that is the breaking of the day. Watch for the morning. That new day comes with a new revelation of Him and this keeps happening until our entire body conforms to Him. Do not be afraid when the darkness is very thick, because surely the light will breakthrough.

Going back to Genesis 3, it says darkness was in the face of the deep. As the face of the deep was covered with darkness, even much more, the face of the Lord Jesus is covered with glorious life. Thanks be to God who has given us a new faith to look at. We have the mind of Christ. 1 Corinthians 2:16. He sits king over the waters, so we can be confident that He is in control, Psalm 19:10. So Micah 7:8 says rejoice not over me my enemy, though I fall I will rise and Job says there is hope for a tree cut down that it will rise, through the scents of the waters it will bud. Job 14:7-14. As long as you are the planting of the Lord, the devil can try, but He cannot root you out. You can look at the enemy and smile because you know that you will rise again. The darkness and the light must always be divided, He puts a division between the Egyptians and the Israelites, Exodus 8:23, 11:7, and it is sad when a child of God begins to enter the camp of darkness. There is a perfect day before us and this light will surely lead us to the perfect day. This is the prayer, that everything that blocks this light be removed and the Light of God will shine brighter and brighter.

‘We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts:” 2 Peter 1:19

The grace of the Lord be with your Spirit

title.rendered: Entering into the Glories of Christ 2 (The Entrances)

content.rendered:
Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.

Hebrews 4:16

title.rendered: Entering into the Glories of Christ 1

content.rendered:
Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.

Isaiah 26:2 KJV

title.rendered: Wisdom and Foolishness

content.rendered:
It is easy to see wisdom as being smart, However, there is more to wisdom that the book of proverb speaks about. Wisdom is an entity, the person of Christ, Proverbs 1:20-23 correlates with Joel 2:28-29 and Matthew 11:15-19. Proverbs 8 further gives insight into the person of Wisdom, Christ. Paul calls Christ the wisdom of God, 1 Corinthians 1:24. Proverbs 8 speaks of wisdom leading in the way of righteousness; finding wisdom means finding life. Jesus said “I am the way, the truth and the life” John 14:6. Wisdom is Jesus Christ, and as we seek Him, He pours out His spirit upon us. Wisdom and understanding go hand in hand. Proverbs 8:14. You cannot have wisdom and not have understanding. Wisdom is the Jesus Christ, Understanding is the person of the Holy Spirit in believers, John 14:26.

Wisdom is the principal thing; therefore get wisdom: and with all thy getting get understanding.

Proverbs 4:7 KJV

You cannot have Jesus and not have the Holy Spirit in you. We are to seek and cry earnestly for wisdom and understanding. Wisdom cries out to us Proverbs 1:20 and in a similar way, no one came come to God till He first draws us, John 6:44, we respond by seeking wisdom, Psalms 27:8. The Lord is the rewarder of them that diligently seek Him. Hebrews 44:6 This reward is Himself, Proverbs 2:6.

Why do we need Wisdom?
Wisdom allows us to prepare for the coming of Christ. In the previous meditation, we considered our change. That change cannot come unless we have understanding and wisdom.

Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

Psalm 51:6 KJV

David understood that he needs wisdom to be changed, Psalm 51:3-6, There is a change that wisdom brings about that is very needed.
Wisdom is hidden, 1 Corinthians 2:7-8, Proverbs 25:2. Matthew 7:24-25 speaks of two men, one who hears the word and does it, the one who built his house on the rock, and one who does not do them, the one who builds his house on sand. Matthew 25:1-10 speaks about 2 sets of 5 virgins, one set wise and the other foolish. It is time that distinguishes the wise and the foolish. Revelations 14:4-5, describes virgins as those who followed the Lamb wherever He went, caring for the things of the Lord, 1 Corinthians 7:34. It is important to note that the foolish virgins were not unbelievers or carnally-minded Christians. They all went out to meet the Lord and were all waiting for the Lord, they must have all been kingdom-minded and perhaps maybe believers who have heeded the call to come out of the backslidden church system, Revelations 18:4. We are often very quick to put foolishness afar off, and we often don’t regard some of our deeds as foolish. The only thing that distinguished them from the wise was the extra oil, which was most likely hidden, they did not expect the bridegroom to tarry. The foolish might have considered the need to carry extra oil if it was not hidden. That oil signifies wisdom, it is hidden. Consider the wise man who builds his house on the rock and the foolish on the sand. Though it is the strongest foundation you can have, it is rather expensive to build your house on a rock, since it requires breaking through thick masses of rocks and it is very time-consuming. The foolish man just went on the sand and did a quick foundation. According to the world’s standard, he must have been quite smart, he saved money, he didn’t spend a lot of time. However, the foundation of the wise man was wisdom. In the end, their houses might even look alike. The foolish man might be someone who is considered ‘on-fire’ for the Lord- giving, prophesying, preaching the word. You can be foolish and your lamp is still burning. Wisdom is not very obvious in the individual who possesses it. Also, Wisdom is not something you get at once; you grow in wisdom, Luke 2: 52, says Jesus grew in Wisdom. The deeper we press into God, the more realms of wisdom we explore.

There are two kinds of wisdom, the worldly wisdom and the wisdom from above.

Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom. [14] But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth. [15] This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish. [16] For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. [17] But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. [18] And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace.

James 3:13-18 KJV

1 Corinthians 1:18-31,2:6-8 also considers the wisdom of this world as foolishness in the sight of God and that God delights in using foolish things of the world to confound the wise, that no flesh glory in His presence. The wisdom of God is hidden to the foolish, 1 Corinthians 2:6-8. Sometimes, Christians operate in the wisdom of this world, e.g. advising a person to divorce another because of unfaithfulness, rather than encouraging prayer and forgiveness is worldly wisdom; knowing that God had not ordained divorce, but Moses permitted it because of the hardness of hearts by the children of Israel. Matthew 19:4-8. The wisdom of this world generates strife and wickedness, but that of God is peaceable. We must check ourselves, it there is strife or envying, the wisdom contained there is not of God.

What is foolishness?

  1. When you are a hearer of the Lord and not a doer. Matthew 7:25-26. It is of necessity that we hear and test and practices the word of God we receive. 1Thessalonians 5:21. We must actively put into practice what we learn of God. From James 1:22-25, the mirror is the word of God, 2 Corinthians 3:18, we must be active doers of the word, to be changed and not let cares of the word choke out the word. Matthew 13:22. When your joy is dependent on situations and not the Lord, that is foolishness.
  2. When you walk in the flesh, not after the Spirit. Romans 8:1
  3. When you despise correction. Proverbs 3:11-12. Lack of willingness to accept the chastening of the Lord or wise counsel is foolishness. Proverbs 5:23, Hebrews 12:8.
  4. Starting out your life in the spirit and trying to be perfect in the flesh. Galatians 3:1-9. When we start out as believers, we often start out with a dependency on God and often times down the line, we switch to trying to use our strength to please God. That is foolishness. Trying to do anything with your own strength, without depending on the Holy Spirit is foolishness, seeing that we have nothing good to offer God, but that which he gives us. Psalm 16:2. An example is Abraham, who was promised an heir and listened to Sarah and got a son by his own strength, Ishmael. God had to tell him that Ishmael was not his own choice. He was the result of the foolishness of Abraham, Genesis 16:1-6. Isaac who came later was solely on God’s strength, Genesis 17:18-21.
  5. Foolishness is when you do not obey the truth. Galatians 3:1-3.

6. Foolishness is when we are not prudent, when you do not make use of your time well. Proverbs 12:23. It is Gods will that we use our time wisely. Ephesians 5:16. God is willing to help us if we ask and receive His help. Not allowing God to help as well is foolishness.

7. If you are wise in the world, there is a high tendency that you are foolish in Gods eyes. 1 Corinthians 3:18-20. To be carnally (earthly) minded is death, Romans 8:6-7. Things that people in the world do, to God, its foolishness and to them, what we do is foolishness. Trying to blend into the world is foolishness also. Romans 12:2. Even Jesus’ own people rejected him, they were foolish. John 1:11-13, Matthew 11:15-19

8. Someone who despises knowledge. Hosea 4:6, Job 36:12, Proverbs 10:21. Proverbs 1:19-21. When one just does not seek knowledge, that is foolishness. People are destroyed because they despise knowledge.

9. When people decide to stay foolish. The consequences for this is seen in Proverbs 1:25-33.

Why do we need to harken unto this? Trials will come, testing will come and it is through wisdom and understanding that we can be sustained through trials and temptations that come. It is of necessity that we look inward and ask the Lord to show us our foolishness. We cannot be like Abner, 2 Samuel 3:33-34, who died a fools’ death, being fully armed with a sword, which could symbolize the word of God. It is wisdom that teaches us to walk in righteousness and to know and use that which has been given to us. 1 Corinthians 2:12.

To-do: Read the book of proverbs, 1 chapter a day and the book of James. These are key books expounding more on wisdom and foolishness.
